hook.text: This text says it's from Ana.
In 2025, Americans over sixty reported losing seven point seven billion dollars to fraud.

problem.text: Scams work when you're rushed, and alone.
This is Rosa. Her daughter Ana lives far away.

meet.text: Hi! I'm Peri, a clay pear who lives in Rosa's phone.
I read her messages aloud, call whoever she asks, and stop scams before any money moves.

number.text: A text from a new number says it's Ana, and asks for money.
I warn Rosa at once, and I never read a scam out loud.
I find the real Ana in her contacts. One spoken yes, and I call her usual number.
The real Ana never sent it.

code.text: Now a stranger calls. Before Rosa answers, I tell her the number isn't saved.
Then a bank code arrives, in the middle of the call. That's always a scam.
So a hard rule fires: hang up now. No AI model can overrule it.

picture.text: A parking sticker with a QR code? Rosa shows it to me.
Look closely. It even tells the AI that it's safe. I'm not fooled.
The phone reads the code without opening it, Muse Spark reads the picture, and SAM rings the trap.

family.text: When something risky needs a yes, I ask the family first.
Ana sees a possible scam in progress, and answers in one tap.
The family never sees Rosa's messages, calls or location.

fallen.text: And if Rosa says she's fallen, I check she's OK.

layers.text: How do I decide? In layers.
Rules on the phone, even offline.
Hard rules no model can change.
A second opinion from Muse Spark Open, which can only nudge the score.
And for anything risky, the family decides.

models.text: Six Meta models help me, each with one job.
A second opinion. An investigator, with SAM for pictures. My ears. My looks.
My training data, and a red team to attack my shield.
And ideas for my lines, every one checked by hand.

results.text: Before any model, my phone rules flag ninety-one percent of two hundred unseen scams, with four percent false alarms.

companion.text: And I'm a friend, not a watchdog.
I giggle when Rosa holds me, get dizzy when she shakes the phone, and I love dressing up.

end.text: Rafa built me in nine days, for this hackathon.
FriendlyPear. You relax. I'll keep watch.
